newsitem.title: USA: BioTime stake raised by WisdomTree group.
newsitem.headline: BioTime stake raised by WisdomTree group.

text.p: A group led by WisdomTree Associates LP said Monday it raised its stake in BioTime Inc to 259,200 common shares or 9.3 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 34,200 common shares between January 16 and January 30 at prices ranging from $27.79 to $33.51 per share.
BioTime, based in Berkeley, Calif., is a development stage company focused on the discovery and development of unique synthetic plasma solutions for use in preservation of body organs and tissues.
